    Cookie Details

    “Cookies” are small text files stored on your computer or device when you visit this website or our mobile app. There are four types of cookies used on this Site. You cannot opt-out of the first type of cookie called “Strictly Necessary Cookies”. Those are always active to ensure the integrity and proper functionality of our website (such as prompting the cookie banner and remembering your settings, to log into your personal account, to redirect you when you log out, etc.). You can control or opt-out of three other types of cookies -- “functional cookies”, “performance and analytics cookies”, and “marketing and advertising cookies” – using the features and buttons below.

    To learn more about each type of cookie before making you selection, please click any of the four “+” symbols next to each cookie type below the header “Manage Consent Preferences”. When you click on the “+” symbol next to each cookie classification, the box will expand with text explaining each cookie classification’s basic purpose. To disable any of the three cookie settings, you may click on the blue toggle switch next to each cookie description. The button will change color from blue (activate) to grey (deactivate) confirming your selection. This allows you flexibility to customize your choices.

    If you do not wish to disable any of the three optional cookie settings on our Site, you may simply click on the box at the bottom of this box the button labeled “Confirm My Choices”. If you prefer to disable all three optional cookies, you may simply click on the box labeled “Necessary Only.” This will automatically disable the three optional cookies.

    Manage Consent Preferences

    Strictly Necessary Cookies

    Always Active

    These cookies are necessary to enable you to move around the Site and use its features, such as accessing secure areas of the Site. Without these cookies, services you have asked for, such as logging into your account and using a shopping cart, cannot be provided. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but then some parts of the site will not work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information. For your security and the security of our Site, we do not allow these cookies to be deactivated.

    Functional Cookies

    These cookies allow our Site to remember choices you make and provide enhanced, more personal or customized features. For instance, the Site needs to remember your login anonymized details, so that you do not have to repeatedly sign into your account when using a particular device to access our Site. The information these cookies collect is anonymized. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. They do not gather any information about you that could be used for advertising or to remember where you have been on the Internet.

    Performance & Analytics Cookies

    These cookies collect information about how many visitors come to our Site, how visitors use our Site, and how we can optimize our site based upon, for instance, which pages visitors use most often and if they encounter error messages from certain web pages. We use third parties to assist us in analyzing this data. These cookies do not collect information that identifies a visitor, as all information these cookies collect is aggregated and anonymized.

    Marketing & Advertising Cookies

    Our Sites use cookies and pixels that may be used by third parties to build a profile of your interests and enable us to show you relevant advertisements on other sites. These cookies and pixels may also enable you to share pages and content you find interesting on our Sites through third-party social networking and other websites. The cookies and pixels do not store Personal Information directly; instead, they use and/or capture unique identifying features of your browser and Internet device. If you do not allow these cookies and pixels, you will experience less targeted advertising and may be unable to share pages or content you find interesting through third-party social networking sites.
